component.name: Observer
component.script:
Function init() m.top.observeField("observe", "setupCallback") m.top.observeField("unobserve", "setupCallback") m.top.observeField("observeScoped", "setupCallback") m.top.observeField("unobserveScoped", "setupCallback") End Function
Function setupCallback(msg) field = msg.GetField() print m.top.id; ".setupCallback field = "; field if type(m.top.targetNode) = "roSGNode" and m.top.targetField <> "" if field = "observe" m.top.targetNode.observeField(m.top.targetField, "eventCallback") else if field = "unobserve" m.top.targetNode.unobserveField(m.top.targetField) else if field = "observeScoped" m.top.targetNode.observeFieldScoped(m.top.targetField, "eventCallback") else if field = "unobserveScoped" m.top.targetNode.unobserveFieldScoped(m.top.targetField) end if end if End Function
Function eventCallback() print m.top.id; ".eventCallback" End Function
